SMTO-CTX-0037 — The task lost its place while paging through notes or results

GUID: 54314dac-9a04-5144-bed5-f1d55641a759
Slug: task-context-cursor-stale
Domain: CTX · Subsystem: task-context

What happened

  • The task was reading a long list or document a page at a time, and the bookmark it used to find the next page no longer matches what is saved. Nothing was changed; the task needs to start that read again.

How to fix — simple steps

  1. Let the task continue and watch its activity for the same read starting over. Starting the read again gives the task a fresh bookmark that matches what is saved now.
  2. If the task keeps repeating this message, select Steer and ask it to restart that read without its old position. The old bookmark will never work again once the notes or search have changed.

What success looks like

  • The task reads the next pages without this message and moves on.

If it still fails

  • Select Copy error details and send them to the person who manages SMTO. Don't change access settings to get past this; the bookmark simply needs to be replaced.

Technical details

Observed condition

  • A Task Context read or search rejected its continuation cursor because it is malformed or no longer matches the current source, revision or query (invalid_or_stale_cursor).

What this means

  • The cursor does not identify the current source and query. The recorded reason and operation message identify the specific condition.

Why this can happen

  • The source rejects the supplied cursor or its revision.

How to diagnose it

  • Inspect the operation, reason, revision and source reference recorded by the producer.

How to fix it

  • Repeat the same task_context read or search without the cursor argument, then continue using only the cursor returned by that new call. Cursors are bound to one source, revision and query; do not reuse a cursor across queries or after the source changes.
  • Repeat the same read or search without its cursor, then use only the newly returned cursor.

Retry and execution caution

  • Correct the indicated argument or refresh the source first; retain existing access checks and revision checks.

How to verify the fix

  • The corrected notebook operation succeeds.

What not to do

  • Do not bypass source access checks or overwrite a revision conflict.

Technical notes

  • An unavailable source does not prove that no relevant information exists.
  • Preserve the occurrence ID and safe request/operation references. Receipts and occurrence facts establish what started or completed; the catalog does not authorize retries or establish execution outcome.

Do not confuse with / related errors

  • SMTO-CTX-0028 — SMTO couldn't find an item in this Task's saved notes
